idea-plugin.name: FBX Diff Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
View FBX models in 3D inside the IDE and compare two revisions side by side.

  • VCS diff of an .fbx file (Git log, Show Diff, Compare with…) opens a two-pane 3D view with synchronized cameras instead of "Cannot show diff for an unknown file type".
  • Statistics with deltas: per-mesh triangles, vertices (close to Unity's imported count), unique positions, bones, blend shapes, UV sets and materials; a LOD summary, animation clips and material usage.
  • Opening an .fbx file shows the same viewer for one file.
  • Clay, original and normal shading, wireframe, skeleton, LOD filter and animation clip playback.

Everything runs locally in the IDE's embedded browser. No data leaves the machine.
